text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #ffffff ring (total 4px). This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while preventing the inner ring from shrinking the touch target on mobile. The trade-off is slightly more CSS, but it guarantees clarity for both keyboard users and touchscreen readers.

name: Reader
text: The 3px/1px ring risks blurring the focus indicator on low-DPI screens where 1px borders may not render crisply. A simpler 4px solid #005fcc ring with a 2px inner #ffffff offset (total 6px) avoids sub-pixel rendering issues while keeping the inner contrast. Test on a 120 PPI display to settle it.
